description.value: Bind one soul — captured, willing, or cowed — into a single weapon, tool, or armor piece you own, and name it. While wielding that item you gain a +1 item bonus to one skill or saving throw, chosen when you bind and fixed after. The soul begins at Temper 0. Each time you critically fail a check with that item, or leave it unused for a week, Temper rises by 1. You may hold exactly one bind; a second requires Dual Bind.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +1 item bonus to a chosen skill or save could be built from a ChoiceSet + FlatModifier, but its uptime is 'while wielding that one specific item' -- there is no held-item-tracking roll option anywhere in pf2e for a predicate to key off, so shipping the FlatModifier would mean either an always-on bonus that overstates the card (no wielding requirement) or a predicate on a roll option nothing sets, which would never fire (a rule element that is schema-valid and semantically null). Temper's rise (on a critical failure with the item, or a week unused) has no engine hook either: it is Cinderfall's own bespoke counter with no actor-schema representation.
